newsitem.title: UK: Uneximbank plans $100-$200 mln public Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Uneximbank plans $100-$200 mln public Eurobond.

text.p: Russia's United Export Import Bank (Uneximbank) plans to launch a debut public Eurobond for up to $200 million, its head of treasury said on Tuesday.
"We plan our first public Eurobond in the middle of this year," Alexander Popov, head of the treasury department at Uneximbank in Moscow told Reuters.
"The estimated size is between $100 million and $200 million. It will be a straight bond for between three to five years," he said.
A mandate for the deal would be awarded by the end of this week, he said.
On Monday, Uneximbank privately placed a $50 million three-year FRN via Merrill Lynch. The bonds were issued by its Dutch subsidiary Unexim International Finance BV.
